document.notes: THIS DOCUMENT ROUTES NOWHERE, deliberately. It is a VERIFICATION document, not a routing source, for two reasons. (1) It arrives too late: the Instructions for Forms 1099-R and 5498 say 'File Form 5498, IRA Contribution Information, with the IRS by June 1, 2026' - after the April filing deadline, so the return is normally already filed when it appears. (2) It reports what was CONTRIBUTED, which is not what is DEDUCTIBLE: the IRA deduction on Schedule 1 line 20 is limited by earned income and, for a taxpayer covered by an employer plan, phased out by modified AGI, and a Roth contribution (box 10) is never deductible at all. The deduction therefore comes from the taxpayer's own assertion worked through the IRA Deduction Worksheet. Use this form to CHECK that assertion - box 1 against the amount claimed, box 10 to catch a Roth contribution claimed as deductible, box 7 for the account type. Box 1 is already exclusive of boxes 2-4, 8-10, 13a and 14a, so those are not components of it. The 2025 Form 1040 instructions for line 20 point at this document: 'A statement should be sent to you by June 1, 2026, that shows all contributions to your traditional IRA for 2025.'
